features.name: Dantu
features.origin: Ghanan god associated with the planting of the corn.

features.name: Ernutet
features.origin: Egyptian cobra-headed goddess of the harvest.

features.name: Kubrick Mons
features.origin: Stanley, American-British film director and screenwriter (1928-1999). His film "2001: A Space Odyssey" (1968) after the screenplay co-wrote with Arthur Clarke tells the story of humanity’s evolution from tool-using hominids to space explorers and beyond.
features.tagline: A mountain sitting in a moat — the ice crust sagged under its weight.

features.name: Argo Chasma
features.origin: Greek mythological ship sailed by Jason and his crew, the Argonauts, from Iolcos to Colchis to retrieve the Golden Fleece, described in the "Argonautica" epic poem by Apollonius Rhodius (3rd cen. BC).

features.name: Mandjet Chasma
features.origin: Egyptian boat that carries the sun god Ra across the sky in the daytime.

features.name: Dorothy
features.origin: American fictional character, protagonist of "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz" and other children’s novels, small girl who visited the magical Land of Oz.

features.name: Caleuche Chasma
features.origin: Chilote (southern Chile) legendary, sentient ghost ship, which could suddenly appear and then quickly disappears again, leaving no evidence of its presence.

features.name: Clarke Montes
features.origin: Sir Arthur C., British author (1917-2008). Many of his novels depict space explorations, among which the most notable is "2001: A Space Odyssey", describing a voyage to Jupiter. This novel was adapted from the screenplay he co-wrote with Stanley Kubrick for the 1968 film.

features.name: Padua Chasmata
features.origin: City in northern Italy founded by Antenor.

features.origin: Son of Mercury by Carmentis, ally of Aeneas against the Latins, mythical king of Arcadia, founded and ruled Pallanteum, built on the future site of Rome.

features.name: Damascus Sulcus
features.origin: Home city of the merchant Ayyub, father of Ghanim and Fitnah in the "Tale of Ghanim Bin Ayyub, the Distraught, the Thrall O’ Love."
features.tagline: Tiger stripe: the most active jet source seen by Cassini.

features.name: Alexandria Sulcus
features.origin: City in the tale "The Sharper of Alexandria and the Chief of Police" from Richard F. Burton's Arabian Nights.
features.tagline: Tiger stripe at the south pole of Enceladus.

features.name: Cairo Sulcus
features.origin: City in the "Tale of Nur Al-Din Ali and his son Badr Al-Din Hassan."
features.tagline: Tiger stripe at the south pole of Enceladus.

features.name: Samarkand Sulci
features.origin: Country ruled over by Zaman, brother of Shahryar.

features.origin: Ceylon (Sri Lanka); the island visited by Sindbad on his 6th voyage.

features.name: Aladdin
features.origin: Hero of the tale; he has the magic lamp.

features.name: Ali Baba
features.origin: Hero of tale who found a great treasure owned by 40 thieves.

features.name: NEAR Shoemaker

features.name: Psyche
features.origin: Beloved of Eros; personification of human soul in Greek mythology.
features.tagline: The largest crater on Eros.

features.name: Charlois Regio
features.origin: Auguste Honore Pierre; French astronomer, independent discoverer of Eros (1864-1910).

features.name: Conamara Chaos

features.name: Thera Macula
features.origin: Greek; place where Cadmus stopped in his search for Europa.

features.name: Thrace Macula

features.name: Callanish

features.name: Pele

features.name: Prometheus

features.name: Tvashtar Paterae
features.origin: Indian sun god and smith who forged the thunderbolt of the thunder god Indra.

features.name: Amirani

features.origin: Thunder god of the Tupi-Guarani Indians of Brazil.

features.name: Curiosity

features.name: Planum Australe
features.tagline: The south polar cap, with a permanent layer of CO2 ice over water ice.

features.name: Gale
features.tagline: 154 km crater with a 5 km layered mountain (Aeolis Mons) explored by Curiosity since 2012.

features.name: Jezero
features.tagline: Ancient lake crater with a river delta; Perseverance is collecting samples here.

features.name: Tharsis Montes

features.name: Opportunity

features.origin: Albedo feature name; changed from Planitia to Planum.

American; steamship that explored the Mississippi, Amazon, and

1886.

features.name: Odysseus
features.tagline: Impact basin 445 km across on a 1,062 km moon.

features.name: Ithaca Chasma
features.origin: An Ionian island, home of Odysseus.
features.tagline: Canyon ≈2,000 km long, wrapping three quarters of the way around Tethys.

features.name: Huygens
features.tagline: The most distant landing ever made, on the dunes of Shangri-La.

mission.name: Huygens
mission.coordinateSource: Karkoschka et al. (2007), Planet. Space Sci. 55; Lebreton et al. (2005), Nature 438

features.name: Kraken Mare
features.origin:
Fabulous sea monster in the Norwegian seas, said to be a mile 
and a half in circumference and to cause a whirlpool when it dives.
features.tagline: The largest sea of liquid methane and ethane on Titan, bigger than the Caspian Sea.

features.name: Ligeia Mare
features.origin: One of the sirens in Greek mythology.
features.tagline: Second-largest hydrocarbon sea; radar measured depths of ≈160 m.

features.name: Xanadu
features.origin: An imaginary country in Coleridge's "Kubla Khan."
features.tagline: Bright continent-sized highland the size of Australia, the first surface feature seen on Titan.

features.name: Shangri La
features.origin: Tibetan mythical land of eternal youth.
features.tagline: Vast dark field of hydrocarbon sand dunes where Huygens landed.

features.name: Ontario Lacus
features.origin: Lake on the border between Canada and the United States.
features.tagline: The largest lake in Titan's southern hemisphere.

features.name: Punga Mare
features.origin: Māori (New Zealand) supernatural being, the father of sharks and lizards. Son of the sea god Tangaroa.

features.name: Selk
features.origin: Egyptian goddess of knowledge, writing, education, and reptiles.
features.tagline: Crater chosen as the landing target of NASA's Dragonfly rotorcraft (arriving 2034).

features.name: Menrva
features.tagline: The largest impact crater on Titan.

features.name: Belet
features.origin: Malay afterworld reached by a flower-lined bridge.

features.name: Sotra Patera
features.tagline: Possible cryovolcano, Titan's deepest known pit.

features.name: Adiri
features.origin: Melanesian afterworld where life is easier than on Earth.

features.name: Doom Mons
features.origin:
Name of a mountain from Middle-earth, the fictional setting
in fantasy novels by J.R.R. Tolkien.

features.name: Hotei Regio
features.origin: One of the seven gods of happiness in Japanese Buddhism. He is the god of contentment, good fortune, and cheerfulness, and he is always smiling.

features.name: Mayda Insula
features.origin: Legendary island in the northeastern region of the Atlantic Ocean.

features.name: Uhlanga Regio
features.origin: Zulu reed from which humanity sprang.
features.tagline: The bright southern polar cap of nitrogen frost.

features.name: Hili
features.tagline: Active nitrogen geyser plume seen by Voyager 2 in 1989.

features.name: Mahilani
features.tagline: One of the dark streaks left by nitrogen geysers seen by Voyager 2.

features.name: Bubembe Regio
features.origin: Island location of temple of Mukasa (Uganda).
features.tagline: Home of the "cantaloupe terrain", unique to Triton.

features.name: Monad Regio
features.origin: Chinese symbol of duality in nature.

features.name: Sipapu Planitia
features.origin: Pueblo (USA) hole or lake of emergence from underworld.

features.name: Maxwell Montes
features.tagline: The highest mountains on Venus, ≈11 km above the mean radius; the only male name on the planet.

features.name: Aphrodite Terra
features.tagline: Equatorial highland roughly the size of South America.

features.name: Ishtar Terra
features.tagline: Northern highland "continent" about the size of Australia.

features.name: Maat Mons
features.origin: Ancient Egyptian goddess of truth and justice.
features.tagline: The highest volcano on Venus, ≈8 km; Magellan data hint at recent eruptions.

features.name: Venera 13
features.tagline: First colour panoramas of Venus; survived 127 minutes.

features.name: Beta Regio
features.tagline: Volcanic rise split by a rift valley.

features.name: Venera 7
features.tagline: First transmission from the surface of another planet (≈475 °C, 90 bar).

features.name: Venera 9
features.tagline: First photograph from the surface of another planet.

features.name: Artemis Corona
features.tagline: A 2,600 km ring structure, the largest corona on Venus.

features.name: Lakshmi Planum
features.origin: Indian goddess of love and war.

features.name: Venera 8
features.tagline: Measured sunlight reaching the surface.

features.name: Sapas Mons
features.origin: Phoenician commerce, travel, and messenger goddess.

features.name: Mead
features.tagline: The largest impact crater on Venus.

features.name: Rheasilvia
features.origin: Rhea Silvia, Roman vestal virgin, mother of Romulus and Remus (c. 770 B.C.).
features.tagline: Impact basin 500 km wide (95% of Vesta's diameter) with a central peak ≈22 km high; source of the HED meteorites.

features.name: Divalia Fossae
features.origin: Roman festival held on December 21 in honor of the goddess Angerona.
features.tagline: Equatorial troughs encircling Vesta, cracks from the Rheasilvia impact.

features.name: Veneneia
features.origin: One of the first Roman vestal virgins.
features.tagline: Older giant basin partly overlapped by Rheasilvia.

features.name: Saturnalia Fossae
features.origin: Three-day Roman festival starting on December 17, with sacrifices, public feasting, gifts, and slaves were waited on by their masters.
